import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long v;
    static long[] cand = new long[17];

    static int recursive(int index, long value) {
        value = Math.abs(value);
        if (index == 0) {
            return (int) value;
        }
        int quotient = (int) (value / cand[index]);
        int nextQuotient = quotient + 1;
        int option1 = quotient * (index + 1) + recursive(index - 1, value - quotient * cand[index]);
        int option2 = nextQuotient * (index + 1) + recursive(index - 1, value - nextQuotient * cand[index]);
        return Math.min(option1, option2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        v = sc.nextLong();
        cand[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            cand[i] = cand[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        System.out.println(recursive(16, v));
        sc.close();
    }
}
